threadNotifications.description: System alerts when a thread finishes, fails, or needs input or approval. Applies to this device while T3 Code is open.
threadNotifications.needsBrowserOrDesktop: Notifications need a supported browser over HTTPS, or the desktop app. Sound only is still available.
threadNotifications.unavailableInBrowser: Notifications are unavailable in this browser. Sound only is still available.
threadNotifications.allowAndRetry: Allow notifications in your browser or system settings, then choose this option again. Sound only is still available.
